title: Prosoc Packet Manifest Card
description: Schema for a human-authored packet manifest card. A manifest names the member cards a normative packet assembles, resolved by prosoc.packet.resolve and consumed by prosoc.packet.assemble.

id.description: Canonical, stable identifier for the manifest. Matches the directory name.

state.description: Machine-readable lifecycle state of the manifest card (see prosoc/scenarios/workflow.md). Authoritative source for the state; the Markdown ## STATUS block's STATE line is a projection of this value, enforced by scripts/validate/status.

builder.description: Identity of the entity assembling packets from this manifest, recorded into the packet's predicate.builder.id.

members.description: Ordered list of member cards a packet assembled from this manifest resolves.

family.description: The member card's family. Never 'manifests' — a manifest cannot name another manifest as a member (prosoc.packet's resolve/assemble is not designed for recursive manifests).

id.description: The member card's locator id within its family (its directory name for card-per-directory families, or 'charter' for the single-source charter family).
